run.procedureSummary: Step 1 Charge: add each cycle's charge to crucibles 1-6; overfill allowed. Step 2 Overflow: process 1 to 6 in order; if contents exceed working volume (10,8,12,6,9,7), cut back to volume and add the excess to the next crucible before its turn (so it can cascade); crucible 6's excess goes to slag. Step 3 State: compare post-overflow contents with marks; BASE with contents >= upper mark (7,6,9,5,7,5) becomes SUPERHEATED; SUPERHEATED with contents <= lower mark (3,2,4,2,3,2) becomes BASE; otherwise unchanged; each change logged. Step 4 Bleed: compute all six amounts first from current contents with the new states, rounded down (BASE floor(q/4), SUPERHEATED floor(q/2)), then move simultaneously: BASE amount to slag; SUPERHEATED amount to the crucible one position lower (i-1), crucible 1's to slag; receivers may exceed volume and are not re-overflowed until the next cycle's step 2 (after cycle 5 it stays). Step 5 Emergency tap: if the six-crucible total is strictly greater than 38, each crucible keeps floor(q/2) and the remainder (q - floor(q/2)) goes to slag.

openPoints.point: Which state governs the bleed in the cycle where a state changes
openPoints.assumption: Step 3 runs before step 4, so the bleed uses the state just set in step 3 of the same cycle.

openPoints.point: Bleed basis and timing (simultaneous vs sequential)
openPoints.assumption: All six bleed amounts are computed from the contents after step 3 before anything moves; an amount received by return launder does not change the receiver's own bleed in that cycle.
The crucible with the next lower position (charged earlier in the 1-to-6 line), i.e. i-1; crucible 1 has none, so its half goes to slag as stated.
Excess received from the previous crucible counts toward the next crucible's own overflow check on its turn in the same pass (one pass, 1 to 6).
'Over 38' is strict: total of exactly 38 does not fire (cycle 5 ended at exactly 38 and the tap did not fire).

openPoints.point: Emergency tap rounding and where the odd unit goes
openPoints.assumption: Each crucible keeps floor(q/2); the rest, ceil(q/2), goes to slag.
Measured after the bleed of the same cycle, including any overfill left in a receiving crucible.

openPoints.point: State marks checked on what contents
openPoints.assumption: Contents after overflow (step 2), not after charge or bleed.
